title: getConfigResponse
description: Response schema variant for get_config, containing consolidated configuration payload and operation result.

command.description: Echoes the command name so clients can map this response to the get_config request.

requestId.description: Request identifier copied from the command, used for request and response correlation.

apiVersion.description: API version used to interpret this response payload.

currentConfig.description: Combined current device configuration across major management domains.

response.description: Execution result object containing status code and result description.
